question: Effect of initiating ICU crystalloid with lactated Ringer's versus 0.9% saline (first ICU fluid-therapy crystalloid: any bolus, or an infusion whose start rate is >= 50 mL/h; intention-to-treat analogue) on chloride change from time zero to ~24 h, MIMIC-IV, active-comparator new-user target-trial emulation
estimand: ICH E9(R1) hypothetical strategy: ATE in eligible stays with the outcome's baseline value, on the outcome at time zero + 24 h had neither death nor hospital discharge occurred before time zero + 24 h and everyone been tested; observed only without an intercurrent event and with a sample in 18-30 h (that sample stands for the 24 h value); assumes intercurrent events and missed testing are independent of the outcome given the baseline adjustment set and arm, and observation positivity
subject: subject_id
inferential_hierarchy: one primary test (chloride change); bicarbonate change descriptive; negative control and benchmark are readiness gates; sensitivity analyses (untruncated weights, no measurement weighting, observed-survivors subset association) reported, not gated

negative_control.definition: last chemistry chloride sampled 24-48 h before time zero; disjoint from the baseline window (24 h before time zero), so never the same specimen as baseline_chloride; cannot be caused by the assignment; analysed complete-case in stays that have it (having the earlier sample is pre-treatment), weighted by a propensity model refitted in that subset
negative_control.rationale: falsification test for confounding that also acts on earlier chloride (e.g. clinicians choosing lactated Ringer's for a rising chloride or acidosis that the last baseline value does not capture); a pass does not bound confounding of the primary outcome; margin 0.5 mmol/L is investigator-chosen

benchmark_note: investigator-chosen directional compatibility check: primary 95% CI entirely below -0.5 mmol/L (balanced fluids lower chloride in SMART, BaSICS and PLUS under sustained fluid policies; those trials do not supply a numerical range for this initiation contrast); not RCT effect reproduction and not validation of identification
